fields.label: Variant
fields.description: The specific product variant produced (template + weight), e.g. Chicken Burger-200G.

fields.label: BOM
fields.description: Bill of Materials (recipe) used for this variant.

fields.label: Batch Reference
fields.description: Human-readable batch reference shown on the production floor.

fields.label: Produced Qty (Nos)
fields.description: Number of finished pieces produced (Nos = number/count).

fields.label: Weight / Piece (g)
fields.description: Standard weight of one finished piece, in grams (g).

fields.label: Source Warehouse
fields.description: Store from which raw materials are issued (Stores).

fields.label: WIP Warehouse
fields.description: WIP = Work In Progress. Raw materials are moved here during manufacturing.

fields.label: Target (FG) Warehouse
fields.description: FG = Finished Goods. The completed product is received into this warehouse.

fields.label: Work Order
fields.description: The ERPNext Work Order created for this batch.

fields.label: Material Transfer Entry
fields.description: Stock Entry (Material Transfer for Manufacture) moving raw materials Source → WIP.

fields.label: Manufacture Entry
fields.description: Stock Entry (Manufacture) consuming WIP materials and receiving finished goods.

fields.label: Waste (Material Issue) Entry
fields.description: Stock Entry (Material Issue) writing off damaged finished pieces from FG.

fields.label: Status
fields.options:
Draft
WO Created
Materials Transferred
Completed
Failed
fields.description: Lifecycle: Draft → WO Created → Materials Transferred → Completed (or Failed).

fields.label: Total Cost
fields.description: ERPNext-computed total production cost for the whole batch.

fields.label: Cost / Piece
fields.description: ERPNext-computed cost of one finished piece (total cost ÷ produced qty).

fields.label: Operator
fields.description: The user who logged this production batch.

fields.label: Materials
fields.description: Actual raw materials consumed in this batch.

fields.label: Loss (process, kg)
fields.description: Process loss is already reflected in material consumption; recorded here for analysis.

fields.label: Error Log
fields.description: Traceback captured if production posting failed.
